name: Ha Long Bay
provinceNote: Portal pages use both tỉnh Quảng Ninh and thành phố Quảng Ninh. From 1 July 2025 the old thành phố Hạ Long is not a district-level city. The wards are address lines inside this place.
summary: You come for limestone towers standing in the water, and a boat small enough that the rock is the subject. The harbor you leave from is Bãi Cháy, or a cabin after the day boats. Route 1 is 3–4 hours. Route 2 is 5–6 hours. Sleep on the bay when that night is the trip. Go to Cát Bà when the other shore of the same property is the trip.
timeNeeded: A day boat, or a night aboard
getThere: Van Don airport, or the road from Hanoi. The harbor minute is Check on arrival.
bestMonths: Clear mornings. Check the flight in June–September.
seoTitle: Ha Long Bay travel guide — boat routes and the harbor
seoDescription: Ha Long from the Bãi Cháy harbor: route 1 is 3–4 hours, route 2 is 5–6 hours. Fees stay in ranges. The road minute from Hanoi is Check on arrival.
intro: Limestone towers stand in the water. You see them from a boat. UNESCO’s English synthesis calls this the most extensive marine-invaded tower karst and prints 65,650 ha, 1,133 islands and islets, and a buffer of 34,140 ha. Other language blurbs on the same page say about 1,600 islands. Both counts stay. The property was inscribed in 1994, with boundary changes in 2000 and 2023, under criteria (vii) and (viii). It was a national scenic site in 1962 and a special national monument in 2009. The property name is Ha Long Bay - Cat Ba Archipelago. The Hạ Long Bay Management Board runs this side. Cát Bà National Park and the Cat Ba Bays board run the other. Bái Tử Long stays inside this water.

The town is the harbor you leave from. Route 1, from Cảng tàu khách quốc tế Hạ Long, is 3–4 hours for Thiên Cung, Đầu Gỗ, and Ba Hang. Route 2 is 5–6 hours for Ti Tốp, Sửng Sốt, and Luồn. The English port line is Beach road, New Beach, Bai Chay ward, 500 m from Sun World. Tuần Châu is the other port in the same fee notice. Between the shores, Quốc lộ 18 uses Cầu Bãi Cháy. A walk minute was not printed. From 1 July 2025, phường Bãi Cháy is the old Hùng Thắng and Bãi Cháy, 25.39 km² and 42,108 people. Phường Hồng Gai is Bạch Đằng, Trần Hưng Đạo, and Hồng Gai, 5.00 km² and 51,333 people. Phường Hạ Long is Hồng Hà and Hồng Hải, 6.08 km² and 52,905 people. That ward is not the whole bay. Phường Hà Tu is 37.60 km² and 29,643 people.

Do not budget one all-in price. The 15 March 2024 tourism page, written as expected from 1 April 2024, prints a port passenger fee of 40,000 to 60,000 đồng a person a time. On that sentence, people 60 and over are reduced 50 percent, and children from 7 to 15 are reduced 20 percent. Route 1 totals 440,000–460,000 đồng, split on the page as 310,000 sightseeing and 150,000 boat. Route 2 totals 490,000–510,000, split as 310,000 and 200,000. Inside the 310,000, the page says 60,000 is the port fee and the remainder in that sentence is 250,000. That split is the article’s own. A heritage-board notice from 17 July 2023, a different instrument, gives free entry under 1.2 m or under 7, and to severely disabled people under the decree it cites, half price for Vietnamese citizens 60 and over, and 20 percent off from age 7 to under 16. The port sentence says 7 to 15. The board sentence says 7 to under 16. Both stay. From 10 December 2025 a bay ticket needs an identity card or a passport. About 3.5 million bay visits in 2025 were nearly 9 percent above 2024, on one page.
gettingAround: The bay is a boat from the Hạ Long passenger port or from Tuần Châu. You do not drive the route. Cảng hàng không quốc tế Vân Đồn is the airport. The airport operator prints Doan Ket Commune, Van Don District, and Vietnam Airlines prints xã Đoàn Kết, huyện Vân Đồn. The civil aviation note says that commune at inauguration on 30 December 2018. Nghị quyết 1679 put the old Vân Đồn communes into đặc khu Vân Đồn. All of those address lines stay. The airline page says about 50 km from thành phố Hạ Long and about 15 km from Cái Rồng. The road minute to the harbor was not printed. Check on arrival. Runway figures disagree: 3.6 km by 45 m and nearly 27,000 m² of terminal, against a runway of 3,600 m and more than 27,000 m². Capacity is 2.5 million passengers and 325 ha. ICAO 4E, ILS Cat II. Buses 14A and 14B are about 3,000–10,000 đồng. The page does not name the harbor stop. Taxi is 11,000–13,000 đồng a kilometre, with a flag fall of 29,500 đồng for the first 2 km, on that one tariff.

Cao tốc CT.06 is Hải Phòng–Hạ Long–Vân Đồn–Móng Cái. Km0 is at Hải An, meeting CT.04 at Km 104+740. The end is Km175+340 at Móng Cái. Hạ Long junctions are Minh Khai Km25+00, Việt Hưng Km30+510, and Đồng Lá Km56+880. The airport junction is Km88+800. The expressway investor says the Hạ Long–Vân Đồn section is nearly 60 km, design speed 100 km/h, and that Hanoi to Van Don fell from 5 hours to about 2.5 hours. That claim is not a clock to the Bãi Cháy piers. A door-to-harbor minute from Hà Nội was not printed. Check on arrival. A Đường sắt Việt Nam page for Kép–Hạ Long exists. No departure was printed. Check on arrival.

Cát Bà is the other shore of the same property since the 2023 boundary change. The 9 June 2024 article says the shortcut is about 7 km and about 200,000 đồng a guest for two ways. A minute was not printed. The same article names the ferry Tuần Châu–Gia Luận and prints no fare and no minute. Both routes stay. It counts about 60 fast boats and tenders, and above 300,000 guests in 2022 and above 400,000 in 2023 through Cảng tàu du lịch quốc tế Tuần Châu. Many crossing boats pass Hòn Trống Mái and skip the other stops. Hải Phòng is the other province on the property and the start of CT.06. A minute to the Hải Phòng center was not printed.

stayAreas.name: Overnight on the bay
stayAreas.summary: The 15 March 2024 tourism page prints an overnight average of 600,000–800,000 đồng a person. It does not say what that ticket includes, and it does not name a boat.

eat: Chả mực Hạ Long is the plate: hot, with bánh cuốn, xôi trắng, or cơm, on the boats and on the Tết table. Xôi chả mực and bún cù kỳ Hạ Long are named beside it. Hải sản is cooked on the spot at Bãi Cháy and along the shore.

Friday and Saturday, phố đi bộ Bài Thơ runs 18:00–24:00 on Long Tiên and Lê Quý Đôn. Công luận also says holidays and Tết. After dark on the Bãi Cháy side, the night article groups phố đi bộ Bãi Cháy, chợ đêm Hạ Long, and Sun Carnival Plaza, and prints no hour. No breakfast dish, no sweet, and no daily drink were named. A stall price was not printed. The food guide is the list.
interestsBody: You come for the boat among the towers, then the two cave routes, Ti Tốp’s sand, and the hill over Cửa Lục.
Dining is the squid cake and the night streets. A night aboard is the stay. The cable car crosses Cửa Lục in the afternoon.

interestGroups.summary: A cabin after the day boats, at the published overnight range.

cards.title: Resort Living
cards.summary: Overnight on the bay averages 600,000–800,000 đồng a person. The page does not name a boat.

interestGroups.title: The boat and the towers
interestGroups.summary: The day is a boat among the limestone, and the pair of rocks the port calls the symbol.

cards.title: Fighting Cock Islet
cards.summary: Hòn Trống Mái, seen from the boat. A landing was not described.

interestGroups.title: The two cave routes
interestGroups.summary: The short boat lands in two caves. The long boat lands in Sửng Sốt and rows through Luồn.
body: Route 1 is 3–4 hours for Thiên Cung, Đầu Gỗ, and Ba Hang. Ba Hang is three small notch caves that open onto two salt lakes. You kayak or take a rowboat. A kayak price was not printed.
The same boat passes Hòn Chó Đá and Hòn Đỉnh Hương. You look from the deck. The port does not say it stops. Route 2 is 5–6 hours for Ti Tốp, Sửng Sốt, and Luồn together.

cards.title: Sung Sot Cave
cards.summary: On Bồ Hòn. The port calls it the widest yet found, 20 m above the sea.

cards.title: Thien Cung Cave
cards.summary: On đảo Đầu Gỗ. About 3,000 m², 20 m above the sea.

cards.title: Dau Go Cave
cards.summary: The same landing as Thiên Cung. The port calls it one of the earliest known caves.

cards.title: Luon Cave
cards.summary: You row or kayak through the notch into a lake.

interestGroups.title: Ti Top
interestGroups.summary: The only island in the bay that Hồ Chí Minh named, with a crescent of sand and a climb.

cards.title: Ti Top Island
cards.summary: Crescent sand, a swim, a kayak, and a climb. The clock is the 5–6 hour route.

interestGroups.title: Núi Bài Thơ
interestGroups.summary: A 106 m hill over Cửa Lục, with the pagoda and the temple at its foot.

blocks.heading: Chùa Long Tiên
paragraphs: At the foot of the hill. The cluster page says it was built in 1941 under the Nguyễn court, with a three-door gate, and that it shares the national ranking of Quyết định 1140-QĐ/BT on 31 August 1992. The festival is when Tết arrives. A lunar day was not printed. A fee is Check on arrival.

blocks.heading: Đền Đức Ông
paragraphs: The temple of Trần Quốc Nghiễn, on the same hill and the same 1992 ranking. Three bays and a rear sanctuary, with Yết Kiêu and Giã Tượng in the side bays. The courtyard is 2,531.8 m² in a 2011 decision and 2,689.8 m² in a 2013 adjustment. Both figures stay.

cards.title: Poem Mountain
cards.summary: The hill, the flag, and the bay. Ranked a national relic on 31 August 1992.

interestGroups.title: The museum
interestGroups.summary: The coal-block building on Trần Quốc Nghiễn, facing Cửa Lục.

cards.title: Quang Ninh Museum
cards.summary: More than 30,000 objects. Adult entry 40,000 đồng on the operator’s citation of the 2018 resolution.

interestGroups.title: The cable car over Cửa Lục
interestGroups.summary: The Queen cable car from Bãi Cháy to Ba Đèo, and the bridge you see from the cabin.

cards.title: Queen Cable Car
cards.summary: Ga Đại Dương to Ga Mặt Trời. Length is printed as 2.2 km and as 2.222 km.

cards.title: Bai Chay Bridge
cards.summary: Quốc lộ 18 between the shores. A length, a year, and a toll were not printed.

faqs.a: Route 1 is 3–4 hours for Thiên Cung, Đầu Gỗ, and Ba Hang. Route 2 is 5–6 hours for Ti Tốp, Sửng Sốt, and Luồn. Those clocks are the whole route. A minute inside one cave was not printed.

faqs.q: What does the bay ticket cost?
faqs.a: The 15 March 2024 page prints route 1 at 440,000–460,000 đồng and route 2 at 490,000–510,000, with a port fee of 40,000–60,000 inside the notice. A 2023 board notice uses different child ages. From 10 December 2025 you need an identity card or a passport. Do not pay one blended price.

faqs.q: How do I get there from Hanoi?
faqs.a: The road is the usual way. A door-to-harbor minute was not printed. The investor’s about 2.5 hours is Hanoi to Van Don, not the Bãi Cháy piers. Check on arrival. A railway page for Kép–Hạ Long exists. No departure was printed.
No morning dish was named on the pages opened. Xôi chả mực is the nearest named plate, and it has no clock. Check on arrival.

season.label: Clear mornings
season.note: June–September, Vietnam Airlines notes fog and heavy rain at Van Don and says to check the flight. Confirm the boat the day you sail. Carnaval has used the late-April and 1 May holiday. In 2026 the night was 18:30–22:30 on 30 April along Trần Quốc Nghiễn. The next date is Check on arrival.
